content.headline: FAMILY-OWNED PROTECTION FOR NEW YORK HOMES.
paragraphs: The Luxury Watch Agency has been protecting new york homes since 1979 — long before 'pest control' meant anything more than a family showing up, doing the job right, and treating your home like it was their own. Four decades later, that hasn't changed. We're still family-owned. We still send real technicians, not scripts. And we still believe a home should feel like a home — not a battleground.

Every treatment we run comes with a simple promise: if pests come back between visits, so do we, free of charge. No fine print, no upsells, no excuses. Just honest work from a team that's been earning new york's trust one home at a time for over 45 years.
That's what wearing the crown means to us — not standing above our customers, but standing behind them.
